## Cash Flow Statement

Set `fromMonth` and `toMonth`. It reads `closes` (every Month Close through `toMonth`), `openings` (posted Opening Balances) and `accounts` (the chart).

`lines` (`CashFlowLine`: `section`, `account`, `label`, `amountMinor`, an internal output shape) starts with net income, then each non-cash account's change over the period, cash in positive. Account types map to operating, investing (fixed assets) or financing (long-term liabilities, equity); bank accounts are cash. The opening-balance lines are taken out of the period: they are the starting position, not a flow.

Totals: `operatingMinor`, `investingMinor`, `financingMinor`; `beginCashMinor` (bank accounts through the month before, plus an opening that falls in the period); `endCashMinor` (bank accounts across all closed months to `toMonth`); and `ties`, true when the start plus the three activities equals the end.

```ts
import { CashFlowStatement } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/accounting/ledger-year';
```

### Non-goals
No operations and no direct-method presentation.

### Example
`Reports/cash-flows-2026`, January through December 2026.
